links.comparator_used: Same models without RAG (training knowledge alone), also compared with and without a predefined diagnosis
links.outcome: Diagnostic and therapeutic accuracy (F1) and RAGAS factual consistency/relevance on ten rheumatology cases
links.effect: Mixtral-8x7b with RAG had the highest diagnostic F1 (72%), therapeutic F1 (73%) and RAGAS score (81%). Nemotron-70b without RAG reached 71% diagnostic F1, and Qwen-Turbo without retrieval reached 72% therapeutic F1. Performance varied substantially across models and configurations.
links.tradeoff: Clinically relevant errors persisted across all models, so expert oversight is still needed.
links.quote: Mixtral-8 × 7b-32768 with RAG achieved the highest diagnostic (72%) and therapeutic (73%) F1 scores.

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation grounding added to existing models
